text:
**The available evidence cannot determine whether the 2023 tree removal was authorized.**

Satellite data supports about 0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss on the property in 2023. The mapped loss included 0.4 hectares of planted eucalyptus and 0.3 hectares outside mapped forest. The evidence does not establish the cause of the loss, who carried it out, or its legal status.

Determining authorization would require relevant permits, regulatory records or other documentation.
